title: STEM Mentors Needed in Frisco, TX Area
description: Provide personalized STEM tutoring, Python coding guidance, and robotics mentorship for younger students in the Frisco and Collin County area. Ideal for high school computer science, tech, and engineering pathway students earning certified NHS service hours.

title: STEM & Robotics Workshop Demonstrator
description: Volunteer demonstrators assist museum educators with hands-on robotics, coding exhibits, Maker space challenges, and science demonstrations for children and families in Frisco, TX. High school CS, engineering, and STEM students welcome.

title: Teen Tech Maker Lab & 3D Printing Assistant
description: High school teen volunteers assist younger students with robotics, Scratch coding, 3D printing equipment, and digital literacy inside the Frisco Library makerspace. Certified hours count towards NHS and Presidential Volunteer Service Awards.

title: Youth Coding Mentor (Scratch & Python)
description: Mentor elementary and middle school students learning Scratch, web development (HTML/CSS), and basic Python algorithms. Student mentors answer coding questions, debug small projects, and inspire future programmers.

title: DATA TECHNOLOGY AI PROMPTER / EVALUATOR
description: Assist senior citizens with digital literacy, testing helpful AI tools, and troubleshooting tablets and computers. Volunteers bridge the digital divide while applying technology and data communication skills in Frisco and Plano, TX.

organization_name: Information Technology Disaster Resource Center, Inc
title: Disaster Tech Response Team - DFW
description: Student technology volunteers support staging, testing, and configuring emergency Wi-Fi equipment, laptops, and networking gear used during regional emergency relief efforts in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

title: Logistics Data & Inventory Systems Assistant
description: Support NTFB logistics teams at the Plano distribution campus with warehouse inventory barcode scanning, data logging, and sorting metrics to optimize regional food pantry deliveries.

title: Software & Robotics Youth Assistant
description: Assist lead instructors with robotics kit assembly, block-based coding, and STEM challenge activities for summer and weekend youth cohorts in Collin County.

title: Patient Comfort Kit Assembly
description: High school volunteer volunteers and pre-med pathway students assist hospital staff in assembling comfort kits and hygiene packages for pediatric and adult patients. Volunteers will also assist with wayfinding, registration desk support, and organizing patient wellness supplies in Frisco, TX. Suitable for teens 14-18 earning NHS and pre-health hours.

title: Blood Drive Check-In Volunteer
description: Youth and student volunteers greet blood donors, manage check-in rosters, provide post-donation refreshments, and ensure a welcoming environment during community mobile blood drives across Collin County and McKinney, TX. Great for students pursuing healthcare careers.

title: Senior Center Health Fair Greeter
description: Support our annual health & wellness fair in Allen, TX! Volunteers assist elderly community members with navigation, guide participants to wellness screening booths, and distribute educational health literature. Teens and student volunteers welcome.

title: Youth Patient Escort & Wellness Volunteer
description: Support hospital navigation, discharge escorting, and patient amenity deliveries at Baylor Scott & White medical facilities in Plano and Frisco, TX. Excellent direct healthcare pathway exposure.

title: Towne Lake Trail Maintenance & Tree Planting
description: Volunteer outdoor workday with the McKinney Parks Foundation! Volunteers will help with prairie conservation, mulching nature trails, planting native saplings, and general park cleanup along scenic McKinney, TX trails. Perfect for teens and environmental clubs.

title: Native Pollinator Habitat Restoration
description: Join community conservationists in restoring native North Texas wildflower meadows, removing invasive weeds, and planting pollinator-friendly flora across Frisco public parks.

title: VolunTEEN Literacy & Reading Buddy
description: Lead interactive storytelling, literacy workshops, and book organization for elementary school youth in Frisco, TX. Inspires youth literacy while earning verified service hours.

organization_name: Boys & Girls Club of Collin County
title: After-School Homework & Reading Tutor
description: Provide after-school academic assistance, reading tutoring, and homework help for K-8 youth at the Frisco branch. Student tutors foster positive study habits and confidence.

title: Saturday Food Pantry Sort
description: Join our Food Pantry shift in Frisco, TX! High school student volunteers inspect, date-check, categorize, and shelve donated pantry staples, produce, and household goods to support local families facing hunger. Ideal for NHS and teen service clubs.

title: Youth Financial Literacy Assistant
description: Assist business educators in delivering interactive entrepreneurship and budgeting games for middle school students in the North Texas area.

title: Community Meal Packing Night
description: Help ensure FISD students do not go hungry over the weekend! Volunteers assemble non-perishable weekend food packs for FISD school children in Frisco, TX. High school students, groups, and families welcome.
